name: Office Setup Variant 2
task:
Please complete the following four-stage office task.

=== Stage 1: Supply Gathering ===
You need to organize 5 client files. Each file needs: printed cover page, stapled contract, and a folder. Supplies: 25 sheets of paper, 5 folders, stapler with 100 staples, label maker with tape.

=== Stage 2: Document Preparation ===
Print and organize the documents.

=== Stage 3: Assembly ===
Bind and compile the documents.

=== Stage 4: Cleanup ===
Dispose of waste and organize workspace.
